changes: New: Project pane — pages in folders and sub-folders under Shapes, dragged into order, coloured and renamed in place; the page tabs show the folder you are in.
New: Dashes — a gallery of patterns and dashes of your own, drawn on a ruler in line widths and kept for every drawing.
New: Line ends and corners (round, square, flat; round, bevelled, sharp) and seven more arrowheads with a spread for each end.
New: Part of a label or equation larger or smaller — select it and press Ctrl+] or Ctrl+[, or use A⁺ and A⁻.
New: Properties pane redesigned, and a new Start screen with recent drawings you can search and pin; F1 lists every shortcut.
Fix: Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y work inside the text you are editing, a word at a time.
Fix: Report a bug — the screenshot now reaches the report (paste it, or drag in the copy saved in Downloads).
Fix: The Assistant's chat box scrolls; the caret sits right after Thai vowels such as ำ; Thai text follows its box's font.
MCP: folders (folder_add, folder_set, folder_delete, folder_list), dashes by name or lengths, line ends and corners, arrowhead spread, \scalebox in labels.
